label: The withholding holder is a willed two-way giver, by its HAS_INTELLECT_1 and one power (inference)
rule: Take the withholding holder and a P5 witness; its giving is by a rational power; its set-up is the same at the withholding world
meaning: Withholding gives a holder y at w that gives each concrete being contingent at w being at w and none at an accessible world v where y exists; P5 supplies one, x. The holder has intellect and one power, so by argument A's conclusion its giving of x at w exercises a rational power; its invariant set-up makes v a world with the same set-up. So y is a willed two-way giver at w. Constructive. Willed retains the registered rational-power/exercise sense; actual governance by a specified apprehended good and exhaustive contrastive explanation are not added to that sense.
